stories.title: 📜 1 Crônicas 1
summaryBullets: Adam, Seth, Enosh, (1:1)
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, (1:2)
Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, (1:3)
Noah, Shem, Ham, e Japheth. (1:4)
Os filhos de Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, e Tiras. (1:5)
Os filhos de Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, e Togarmah. (1:6)
Os filhos de Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, e Rodanim. (1:7)
Os filhos de Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put, e Canaan. (1:8)
Os filhos de Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, e Sabteca. Os filhos de Raamah: Sheba e Dedan. (1:9)
Cush gerou Nimrod; foi o primeiro na terra a ser um homem poderoso. (1:10)
Egypt gerou Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim, (1:11)
Pathrusim, Casluhim (de onde vieram os filisteus), e Caphtorim. (1:12)
Canaan gerou Sidon o seu primogénito e Heth, (1:13)
and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, (1:14)
the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites, (1:15)
the Arvadites, the Zemarites, e the Hamathites. (1:16)
Os filhos de Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, e Aram. E os filhos de Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, e Meshech. (1:17)
Arpachshad gerou Shelah, e Shelah gerou Eber. (1:18)
To Eber nasceram two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, porque nos seus dias a terra foi dividida, e o nome do seu irmão era Joktan. (1:19)
Joktan gerou Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, (1:20)
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, (1:21)
Obal, Abimael, Sheba, (1:22)
Ophir, Havilah, e Jobab; all estes foram os filhos de Joktan. (1:23)
Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah, (1:24)
Eber, Peleg, Reu, (1:25)
Serug, Nahor, Terah, (1:26)
Abram, that is, Abraham. (1:27)
Os filhos de Abraham: Isaac e Ishmael. (1:28)
Estas são as suas genealogias: o primogénito de Ishmael, Nebaioth, e Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, (1:29)
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, (1:30)
Jetur, Naphish, e Kedemah. These are os filhos de Ishmael. (1:31)
Os filhos de Keturah, Abraham's concubina: deu à luz Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, e Shuah. Os filhos de Jokshan: Sheba e Dedan. (1:32)
Os filhos de Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, e Eldaah. All estes foram os descendentes de Keturah. (1:33)
Abraham gerou Isaac. Os filhos de Isaac: Esau e Israel. (1:34)
Os filhos de Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, e Korah. (1:35)
Os filhos de Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, e Timna e Amalek. (1:36)
Os filhos de Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, e Mizzah. (1:37)
Os filhos de Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, e Dishan. (1:38)
Os filhos de Lotan: Hori e Homam; e Lotan tinha por irmã Timna. (1:39)
Os filhos de Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, e Onam. Os filhos de Zibeon: Aiah e Anah. (1:40)
O filho de Anah: Dishon. Os filhos de Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, e Cheran. (1:41)
Os filhos de Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, e Akan. Os filhos de Dishan: Uz e Aran. (1:42)
Estes são os kings que reinaram na terra de Edom antes de qualquer rei reinar sobre os filhos de Israel: Bela o filho de Beor, e a sua cidade era Dinhabah. (1:43)
Bela morreu, e Jobab o filho de Zerah of Bozrah reinou em seu lugar. (1:44)
Jobab morreu, e Husham da terra dos Temanites reinou em seu lugar. (1:45)
Husham morreu, e Hadad o filho de Bedad, que derrotou Midian no campo de Moab, reinou em seu lugar, e a sua cidade era Avith. (1:46)
Hadad morreu, e Samlah of Masrekah reinou em seu lugar. (1:47)
Samlah morreu, e Shaul of Rehoboth junto ao Eufrates reinou em seu lugar. (1:48)
Shaul morreu, e Baal-hanan o filho de Achbor reinou em seu lugar. (1:49)
Baal-hanan morreu, e Hadad reinou em seu lugar, e a sua cidade era Pai; o nome da sua esposa era Mehetabel, filha de Matred, filha de Me-zahab. (1:50)
Hadad morreu also. Os chefes de Edom were: chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, (1:51)
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, (1:52)
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, (1:53)
Magdiel, e Iram; these are os chefes de Edom. (1:54)

stories.title: 📜 1 Crônicas 2
summaryBullets: These are os filhos de Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, (2:1)
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, e Asher. (2:2)
Os filhos de Judah: Er, Onan, e Shelah; these three Bath-shua the Canaanite bore to him. Ora Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in the sight of o SENHOR, e he put him to death. (2:3)
His daughter-in-law Tamar also bore him Perez e Zerah. Judah had five sons in all. (2:4)
Os filhos de Perez: Hezron e Hamul. (2:5)
Os filhos de Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, e Dara, five in all. (2:6)
O filho de Carmi se chamava Acã e trouxe calamidade sobre Israel ao tomar para si despojos consagrados para o Senhor. (2:7).
O filho de Ethan: Azariah. (2:8)
Os filhos de Hezron who nasceram to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, e Chelubai. (2:9)
Ram gerou Amminadab, e Amminadab gerou Nahshon, prince of os filhos de Judah. (2:10)
Nahshon gerou Salmon, Salmon gerou Boaz, (2:11)
Boaz gerou Obed, Obed gerou Jesse. (2:12)
Jesse gerou Eliab o seu primogénito, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third, (2:13)
Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth, (2:14)
Ozem the sixth, David the seventh. (2:15)
E their sisters were Zeruiah e Abigail. Os filhos de Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, e Asahel, three. (2:16)
Abigail bore Amasa, e the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite. (2:17)
Caleb o filho de Hezron gerou children by his wife Azubah e by Jerioth, e estes foram her sons: Jesher, Shobab, e Ardon. (2:18)
When Azubah morreu, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur. (2:19)
Hur gerou Uri, e Uri gerou Bezalel. (2:20)
Afterward Hezron went in to filha de Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old, e deu à luz him Segub. (2:21)
E Segub gerou Jair, who had twenty-three cities in a terra de Gilead. (2:22)
But Geshur e Aram took from them Havvoth-jair, Kenath, e its villages, sixty towns. All estes foram descendants of Machir, the father of Gilead. (2:23)
After the death of Hezron, Caleb went in to Ephrathah, the wife of Hezron his father, e deu à luz him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa. (2:24)
Os filhos de Jerahmeel, o primogénito de Hezron: Ram, o seu primogénito, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, e Ahijah. (2:25)
Jerahmeel also had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam. (2:26)
Os filhos de Ram, o primogénito de Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, e Eker. (2:27)
Os filhos de Onam: Shammai e Jada. Os filhos de Shammai: Nadab e Abishur. (2:28)
The name of Abishur's wife was Abihail, e deu à luz him Ahban e Molid. (2:29)
Os filhos de Nadab: Seled e Appaim; e Seled morreu childless. (2:30)
mas Apaim teve um filho chamado Isi. O filho de Isi se chamava Sesã, e o filho de Sesã, Alai. (2:31).
Os filhos de Jada, Shammai's brother: Jether e Jonathan; e Jether morreu childless. (2:32)
Os filhos de Jonathan: Peleth e Zaza. These were os descendentes de Jerahmeel. (2:33)
Ora Sheshan had no sons, only daughters, but Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarha. (2:34)
So Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to Jarha his servant, e deu à luz him Attai. (2:35)
Attai gerou Nathan, e Nathan gerou Zabad. (2:36)
Zabad gerou Ephlal, e Ephlal gerou Obed. (2:37)
Obed gerou Jehu, e Jehu gerou Azariah. (2:38)
Azariah gerou Helez, e Helez gerou Eleasah. (2:39)
Eleasah gerou Sismai, e Sismai gerou Shallum. (2:40)
Shallum gerou Jekamiah, e Jekamiah gerou Elishama. (2:41)
Os filhos de Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha o seu primogénito, who was the father of Ziph, e his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron. (2:42)
Os filhos de Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, e Shema. (2:43)
Shema gerou Raham, the father of Jorkeam, e Rekem gerou Shammai. (2:44)
O filho de Shammai: Maon, e Maon was the father of Beth-zur. (2:45)
Ephah also, Caleb's concubina, bore Haran, Moza, e Gazez; e Haran gerou Gazez. (2:46)
Os filhos de Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, e Shaaph. (2:47)
Maacah, Caleb's concubina, bore Sheber e Tirhanah. (2:48)
She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah e the father of Gibea; e filha de Caleb was Achsah. (2:49)
These were os descendentes de Caleb. Os filhos de Hur o primogénito de Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim, (2:50)
Salma the father of Bethlehem, e Hareph the father of Beth-gader. (2:51)
Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had other sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth. (2:52)
E os clãs de Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, e the Mishraites; from these came the Zorathites e the Eshtaolites. (2:53)
Os filhos de Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, e half of the Manahathites, the Zorites. (2:54)
Os clãs de scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, e the Sucathites. Estes são os Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of a casa de Rechab. (2:55)

stories.title: 📜 1 Crônicas 3
summaryBullets: These are os filhos de David who nasceram to him in Hebron: o primogénito, Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess, (3:1)
the third, Absalom, whose mother was Maacah, filha de Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith; (3:2)
the fifth, Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah. (3:3)
Six nasceram to him in Hebron, where he reigned seven years e six months. E he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem. (3:4)
These nasceram to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, e Solomon, four by Bath-shua, filha de Ammiel; (3:5)
then Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet, (3:6)
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, (3:7)
Elishama, Eliada, e Eliphelet, nine. (3:8)
All estes foram David's sons, besides os filhos de the concubines, e Tamar was their sister. (3:9)
Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son, (3:10)
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son, (3:11)
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son, (3:12)
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son, (3:13)
Amon his son, Josiah his son. (3:14)
Os filhos de Josiah: Johanan o primogénito, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum. (3:15)
Os descendentes de Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son. (3:16)
E os filhos de Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son, (3:17)
Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, e Nedabiah. (3:18)
Os filhos de Pedaiah: Zerubbabel e Shimei. E os filhos de Zerubbabel: Meshullam e Hananiah, e Shelomith was their sister; (3:19)
and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, e Jushab-hesed, five. (3:20)
Os filhos de Hananiah: Pelatiah e Jeshaiah, his son Rephaiah, his son Arnan, his son Obadiah, his son Shecaniah. (3:21)
O filho de Shecaniah: Shemaiah. E os filhos de Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, e Shaphat, six. (3:22)
Os filhos de Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, e Azrikam, three. (3:23)
Os filhos de Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, e Anani, seven. (3:24)

stories.title: 📜 1 Crônicas 4
summaryBullets: Os filhos de Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, e Shobal. (4:1)
Reaiah o filho de Shobal gerou Jahath, e Jahath gerou Ahumai e Lahad. These were os clãs de the Zorathites. (4:2)
These were os filhos de Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, e Idbash; e the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi, (4:3)
and Penuel was the father of Gedor, e Ezer the father of Hushah. These were os filhos de Hur, o primogénito de Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem. (4:4)
Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah e Naarah; (4:5)
Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, e Haahashtari. These were os filhos de Naarah. (4:6)
Os filhos de Helah: Zereth, Izhar, e Ethnan. (4:7)
Koz gerou Anub, Zobebah, e os clãs de Aharhel, o filho de Harum. (4:8)
Jabez was more honorable than his brothers; e his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him in pain." (4:9)

Jabez called upon o Deus de Israel, saying, "Oh that you would bless me e enlarge my border, e that your hand might be with me, e that you would keep me from harm so that it might not bring me pain!" And God granted what he asked. (4:10)
Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, gerou Mehir, who was the father of Eshton. (4:11)
Eshton gerou Beth-rapha, Paseah, e Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. Estes são os men of Recah. (4:12)
Os filhos de Kenaz: Othniel e Seraiah; e os filhos de Othniel: Hathath e Meonothai. (4:13)
Meonothai gerou Ophrah; e Seraiah gerou Joab, the father of Ge-harashim, so-called because they were craftsmen. (4:14)
Os filhos de Caleb o filho de Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, e Naam; e o filho de Elah: Kenaz. (4:15)
Os filhos de Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, e Asarel. (4:16)

Os filhos de Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, e Jalon. These are os filhos de Bithiah, filha de Pharaoh, whom Mered married; e she conceived e bore Miriam, Shammai, e Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa. (4:17)
E his Judahite wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, e Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. (4:18)
Os filhos de the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite e Eshtemoa the Maacathite. (4:19)
Os filhos de Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, e Tilon. Os filhos de Ishi: Zoheth e Ben-zoheth. (4:20)
Os filhos de Shelah o filho de Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, e os clãs de a casa de linen workers at Beth-ashbea; (4:21)
and Jokim, e the men of Cozeba, e Joash, e Saraph, who ruled in Moab e returned to Lehem (the records are ancient). (4:22)
These were the potters who were inhabitants of Netaim e Gederah. They lived there in o rei's service. (4:23)
Os filhos de Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul; (4:24)
Shallum was his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son. (4:25)
Os filhos de Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son. (4:26)
Shimei had sixteen sons e six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, nor did all their clan multiply like the men of Judah. (4:27)
They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual, (4:28)
Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, (4:29)
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, (4:30)
Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, e Shaaraim. These were their cities until David reigned. (4:31)
E their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, e Ashan, five cities, (4:32)
along with all their villages that were around these cities as far as Baal. These were their settlements, e they kept a genealogical record. (4:33)
Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah o filho de Amaziah, (4:34)
Joel, Jeú, filho de Josibias, filho de Seraías, filho de Asiel; (4:35).
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, (4:36)
e Ziza, filho de Sifi, filho de Alom, filho de Jedaías, filho de Sinri e filho de Semaías. (4:37).
these mentioned by name were princes in their clans, e their fathers' houses increased greatly. (4:38)
e mudaram-se para a região de Gerar, na parte leste do vale, à procura de pastos para seus rebanhos. (4:39).
Encontraram ali muitas pastagens boas, e a terra era ampla, tranquila e pacífica. (4:40).

Mas, durante o reinado de Ezequias, rei de Judá, esses líderes de Simeão invadiram a região e destruíram completamente as habitações dos descendentes de Cam e dos meunitas. Hoje não resta vestígio deles. Mataram todos que viviam ali e tomaram a terra para si, pois queriam bons pastos para seus rebanhos. (4:41).
E some of them, five hundred men of the Simeonites, went to Mount Seir, having as their leaders Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, e Uzziel, os filhos de Ishi. (4:42)
They defeated the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped, e they have lived there to this day. (4:43)

summaryBullets: Os filhos de Reuben o primogénito de Israel (for he was o primogénito, but because he defiled his father's couch, his birthright was given to os filhos de Joseph o filho de Israel, so that he could not be enrolled as the oldest son; (5:1)
though Judah became strong among his brothers e a chief came from him, yet the birthright belonged to Joseph), (5:2)
the sons of Reuben, o primogénito de Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, e Carmi. (5:3)
Os filhos de Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son, (5:4)
Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son, (5:5)
e Beera. Beera era o chefe dos rubenitas quando foram levados ao cativeiro por Tiglate-Pileser, rei da Assíria. (5:6).
E his kinsmen by their clans, when the genealogy of their generations was recorded: the chief, Jeiel, e Zechariah, (5:7)
e Belá, filho de Azaz, filho de Sema, filho de Joel. (5:8).
Uma vez que tinham tantos rebanhos na terra de Gileade, espalharam-se para o leste, em direção ao limite do deserto que se estende para o rio Eufrates. (5:9).
E in the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who fell into their hand. E they lived in their tents throughout all the region east of Gilead. (5:10)
Os filhos de Gad lived over against them in a terra de Bashan as far as Salecah: (5:11)
Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, e Shaphat in Bashan. (5:12)
E their kinsmen according to their fathers' houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, e Eber, seven. (5:13)
Todos esses foram descendentes de Abiail, filho de Huri, filho de Jaroa, filho de Gileade, filho de Micael, filho de Jesisai, filho de Jado, filho de Buz. (5:14).
Ahi o filho de Abdiel, son of Guni, was chief in their fathers' houses, (5:15)
and they lived in Gilead, in Bashan e in its towns, e in all the pasturelands of Sharon to their limits. (5:16)
Todos foram listados nos registros genealógicos no tempo de Jotão, rei de Judá, e de Jeroboão, rei de Israel. (5:17).
The Reubenites, the Gadites, e the half-tribe of Manasseh had valiant men who carried shield e sword, e drew the bow, expert in war, 44,760, ready for service. (5:18)
They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, e Nodab. (5:19)
Durante a batalha, clamaram a Deus e ele atendeu às suas orações, pois confiaram nele. Assim, os hagarenos e todos os seus aliados foram derrotados. (5:20).
They carried off their livestock: 50,000 of their camels, 250,000 sheep, 2,000 donkeys, e 100,000 men alive. (5:21)
For many fell, because the war was of God. E they lived in their place until the exile. (5:22)
A meia tribo de Manassés era numerosa e se espalhou por toda a terra, desde Basã até Baal-Hermom, Senir e o monte Hermom. (5:23).
These were the heads of their fathers' houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, e Jahdiel, mighty warriors, famous men, heads of their fathers' houses. (5:24)
Contudo, essas tribos foram infiéis ao Deus de seus antepassados. Adoraram os deuses das nações que Deus havia destruído diante deles. (5:25).

So o Deus de Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, e he took them into exile, namely, the Reubenites, the Gadites, e the half-tribe of Manasseh, e brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, e the river Gozan, to this day. (5:26)

O filho de Uzzi: Izrahiah. E os filhos de Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, e Isshiah, all five of them were chief men. (7:3)
E along with them, by their generations, according to their fathers' houses, were units of the army for war, 36,000, for they had many wives e sons. (7:4)
Their kinsmen belonging to all os clãs de Issachar were in all 87,000 mighty warriors, enrolled by genealogy. (7:5)
Os filhos de Benjamin: Bela, Becher, e Jediael, three. (7:6)
Os filhos de Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, e Iri, five, heads of fathers' houses, mighty warriors; e their enrollment by genealogies was 22,034. (7:7)
Os filhos de Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, e Alemeth. All estes foram os filhos de Becher. (7:8)
E their enrollment by genealogies, according to their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty warriors, was 20,200. (7:9)
O filho de Jediael: Bilhan. E os filhos de Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, e Ahishahar. (7:10)
All estes foram os filhos de Jediael according to the heads of their fathers' houses, mighty warriors, 17,200, ready for service in war. (7:11)
E Shuppim e Huppim were os filhos de Ir, Hushim o filho de Aher. (7:12)
Os filhos de Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, e Shallum, os descendentes de Bilhah. (7:13)

E Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, e she called his name Peresh; e the name of his brother was Sheresh; e his sons were Ulam e Rakem. (7:16)
O filho de Ulam: Bedan. These were os filhos de Gilead o filho de Machir, son of Manasseh. (7:17)
E his sister Hammoleketh bore Ishhod, Abiezer, e Mahlah. (7:18)
Os filhos de Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, e Aniam. (7:19)

Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, e Ezer e Elead, whom the men of Gath who nasceram in the land killed, because they came down to raid their livestock. (7:21)

E Ephraim went in to his wife, e she conceived e bore a son. E he called his name Beriah, because disaster had befallen his house. (7:23)
His daughter was Sheerah, who built both Lower e Upper Beth-horon, e Uzzen-sheerah. (7:24)
Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son, (7:25)
Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son, (7:26)
Nun his son, Joshua his son. (7:27)

also along the borders of the Manassites, Beth-shean e its towns, Taanach e its towns, Megiddo e its towns, Dor e its towns. In these lived os filhos de Joseph o filho de Israel. (7:29)

Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, e Beera. (7:37)

Os filhos de Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, e Rizia. (7:39)

and Mikloth, who gerou Shimeah. Ora these also lived opposite their kinsmen in Jerusalem, with their kinsmen. (8:32)

stories.title: 📜 1 Crônicas 9
summaryBullets: Todo o Israel foi listado nos registros genealógicos do Livro dos Reis de Israel. (9:1).
Ora the first to dwell again in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, e the temple servants. (9:2)
E some of o povo de Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, e Manasseh lived in Jerusalem: (9:3)
Uma das famílias a voltar foi a de Utai, filho de Amiúde, filho de Onri, filho de Inri, filho de Bani, descendente de Perez, filho de Judá. (9:4).
E of the Shilonites: Asaiah o primogénito, e his sons. (9:5)
Of os filhos de Zerah: Jeuel e their kinsmen, 690. (9:6)
Da tribo de Benjamim, alguns dos que voltaram foram: Salu, filho de Mesulão, filho de Hodavias, filho de Hassenua; (9:7).
Ibneias, filho de Jeroão; Elá, filho de Uzi, filho de Micri; e Mesulão, filho de Sefatias, filho de Reuel, filho de Ibnias. (9:8).
and their kinsmen according to their generations, 956. All estes foram heads of fathers' houses according to their fathers' houses. (9:9)
Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin, (9:10)
Azarias, filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube. Azarias era o principal encarregado da casa de Deus. (9:11).

Outros sacerdotes que voltaram foram: Adaías, filho de Jeroão, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias; e Masai, filho de Adiel, filho de Jazera, filho de Mesulão, filho de Mesilemite, filho de Imer. (9:12).
Ao todo, voltaram 1.760 sacerdotes. Foram chefes de clãs e homens muito capazes. Eram responsáveis por servir na casa de Deus. (9:13).
Dos levitas, os que voltaram foram: Semaías, filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, descendente de Merari; (9:14).
Baquebacar; Heres; Galal; Matanias, filho de Mica, filho de Zicri, filho de Asafe; (9:15).
Obadias, filho de Semaías, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum; e Berequias, filho de Asa, filho de Elcana, que morava na região de Netofate. (9:16).
The gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, e their kinsmen (Shallum was the chief); (9:17)
Antes dessa época, eram responsáveis pela Porta do Rei, do lado leste. Eram guardas das portas dos acampamentos dos levitas. (9:18).

Salum era filho de Coré, descendente de Abiasafe, do clã de Corá. Ele e seus parentes, os coraítas, eram responsáveis por guardar a entrada do santuário, como seus antepassados haviam guardado a entrada do tabernáculo. (9:19).
E Phinehas o filho de Eleazar was the chief officer over them in time past; o SENHOR was with him. (9:20)
Zechariah o filho de Meshelemiah was gatekeeper at the entrance of the tent of meeting. (9:21)

Ao todo, havia 212 guardas das portas naquele tempo, e foram listados nos registros genealógicos de seus povoados. Os antepassados deles haviam sido nomeados por Davi e por Samuel, o vidente, porque eram homens de confiança. (9:22).
So they e their sons were in charge of the gates of a casa de o SENHOR, that is, a casa de the tent, as guards. (9:23)
The gatekeepers were on the four sides, east, west, north, e south. (9:24)
E their kinsmen who were in their villages were obligated to come in every seven days, in turn, to be with these, (9:25)
Os quatro principais guardas das portas, todos levitas, eram oficiais de confiança, pois eram responsáveis pelas salas e pelos tesouros da casa de Deus. (9:26).
E they lodged around a casa de God, for on them lay the duty of watching, e they had charge of opening it every morning. (9:27)
Alguns dos guardas das portas foram nomeados para cuidar dos diversos objetos usados no culto. Conferiam tudo que era retirado e devolvido, para que nada se perdesse. (9:28).
Others of them were appointed over the furniture e over all the holy utensils, also over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the incense, e the spices. (9:29)
Others, of os filhos de the priests, prepared the mixing of the spices, (9:30)
and Mattithiah, one of the Levites, o primogénito de Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with making the flat cakes. (9:31)
E alguns membros do clã de Coate eram encarregados de preparar os pães colocados sobre a mesa todos os sábados. (9:32).
Os músicos, todos chefes de famílias levitas, moravam no templo. Eram isentos de outras responsabilidades, pois realizavam seu serviço dia e noite. (9:33).
These were heads of fathers' houses of the Levites, according to their generations, leaders. These lived in Jerusalem. (9:34)
In Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, e the name of his wife was Maacah, (9:35)
and o seu primogénito son Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, (9:36)
Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, e Mikloth. (9:37)
Mikloth gerou Shimeam; e these also lived opposite their kinsmen in Jerusalem, with their kinsmen. (9:38)
Ner gerou Kish, Kish gerou Saul, Saul gerou Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, e Eshbaal. (9:39)
O filho de Jonathan was Merib-baal, e Merib-baal gerou Micah. (9:40)
Os filhos de Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, e Ahaz. (9:41)

Moza gerou Binea, e Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son. (9:43)
Azel had six sons e these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, e Hanan. These were os filhos de Azel. (9:44)

stories.title: ⚔️ 1 Crônicas 10
summaryBullets: Os filisteus pelejaram contra Israel, e os homens de Israel fugiram de diante dos filisteus e caíram mortos no monte Gilboa. (10:1)
Os filisteus alcançaram Saul e os seus filhos, e mataram Jônatas, Abinadabe e Malquisua, filhos de Saul. (10:2)
A batalha se agravou contra Saul, e os flecheiros o alcançaram, e ele foi ferido pelos flecheiros. (10:3)

Então Saul disse ao seu escudeiro: "Desembainha a tua espada e trespassa-me com ela, para que não venham estes incircuncisos e me maltratem". Mas o seu escudeiro não quis, porque tinha muito medo. Então Saul tomou a sua própria espada e lançou-se sobre ela. (10:4)
Quando o seu escudeiro viu que Saul havia morrido, ele também se lançou sobre a sua espada e morreu. (10:5)
Assim morreu Saul; ele, os seus três filhos e toda a sua casa morreram juntos. (10:6)

Quando todos os homens de Israel que estavam no vale viram que o exército tinha fugido e que Saul e os seus filhos tinham morrido, abandonaram as suas cidades e fugiram, e os filisteus vieram e habitaram nelas. (10:7)
No dia seguinte, quando os filisteus vieram despojar os mortos, acharam Saul e os seus filhos caídos no monte Gilboa. (10:8)
Despojaram-no e tomaram a sua cabeça e as suas armas, e enviaram mensageiros por toda a terra dos filisteus para levar as boas novas aos seus ídolos e ao povo. (10:9)
Puseram as suas armas no templo dos seus deuses e fixaram a sua cabeça no templo de Dagom. (10:10)
Mas quando todo o Jabes-Gileade ouviu tudo o que os filisteus tinham feito a Saul, (10:11)

todos os homens valentes se levantaram e tomaram o corpo de Saul e os corpos dos seus filhos, e levaram-nos a Jabes. E sepultaram os seus ossos debaixo do carvalho em Jabes e jejuaram sete dias. (10:12)
Assim morreu Saul pela sua infidelidade; foi infiel ao SENHOR porque não guardou o mandado do SENHOR, e também consultou uma médium, buscando orientação. (10:13)
Não buscou orientação do SENHOR. Por isso o SENHOR o fez morrer e transferiu o reino a Davi, filho de Jessé. (10:14)

stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 11
summaryBullets: Então all Israel gathered together to David at Hebron e said, "Behold, we are your bone e flesh." (11:1)
“No passado, quando Saul era rei, era você que liderava o exército de Israel. E o Senhor, seu Deus, lhe disse: ‘Você será o pastor do meu povo, Israel. Será o líder do meu povo, Israel’.” (11:2).

So all the elders of Israel came to o rei at Hebron, e David made a covenant with them at Hebron before o SENHOR. E they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of o SENHOR by Samuel. (11:3)
E David e all Israel went to Jerusalem, that is, Jebus, where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land. (11:4)
The inhabitants of Jebus disse a David, "You will not come in here." Nevertheless, David took the stronghold of Zion, that is, a cidade de David. (11:5)
David said, "Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief e commander." And Joab o filho de Zeruiah went up first, so he became chief. (11:6)
E David lived in the stronghold; therefore it was called a cidade de David. (11:7)
Ampliou a cidade, desde o aterro até a região ao redor, enquanto Joabe reconstruiu o restante da cidade. (11:8).
E David became greater e greater, for o SENHOR of hosts was with him. (11:9)
Ora these are the chiefs of David's mighty men, who gave him strong support in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of o SENHOR concerning Israel. (11:10)
This is an account of David's mighty men: Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, was chief of the three. He wielded his spear against 300 whom he killed at one time. (11:11)
E next to him among the three mighty men was Eleazar o filho de Dodo, the Ahohite. (11:12)
Estava com Davi quando os filisteus se reuniram para a batalha em Pas-Damim e atacaram os israelitas numa plantação de cevada. O exército israelita fugiu, (11:13).
mas Eleazar e Davi mantiveram sua posição no meio do campo e derrotaram os filisteus. O Senhor os salvou e lhes deu grande vitória. (11:14).

Certa vez, Davi estava na rocha junto à caverna de Adulão, e o exército filisteu estava acampado no vale de Refaim. Os Três — que faziam parte dos Trinta, um grupo de elite entre os valentes de Davi — desceram para encontrá-lo em Adulão. (11:15).
Nessa ocasião, Davi estava na fortaleza, e um destacamento filisteu havia ocupado a cidade de Belém. (11:16).
E David said longingly, "Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem that is by the gate!" (11:17)

Então os Três atravessaram as fileiras dos filisteus, tiraram água do poço junto ao portão de Belém e a trouxeram a Davi. Ele, porém, se recusou a bebê-la. Em vez disso, derramou-a no chão como oferta ao Senhor. (11:18).

and said, "Far be it from me before my God that I should do this. Shall I drink the lifeblood of these men? For at the risk of their lives they brought it." Therefore he would not drink it. These things the three mighty men did. (11:19)
Ora Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the thirty. E he wielded his spear against 300 men e killed them e won a name beside the three. (11:20)
Abisai era o mais conhecido dos Trinta e era seu comandante, embora não fosse um dos Três. (11:21).

E Benaiah o filho de Jehoiada was a valiant man of Kabzeel, a doer of great deeds. He struck down two heroes of Moab. He also went down e struck down a lion in a pit on a day when snow had fallen. (11:22)

E he struck down an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits tall. The Egyptian had in his hand a spear like a weaver's beam, but Benaiah went down to him with a staff e snatched the spear out of the Egyptian's hand e killed him with his own spear. (11:23)
These things did Benaiah o filho de Jehoiada, e won a name beside the three mighty men. (11:24)
Foi mais honrado que qualquer outro membro dos Trinta, embora não fosse um dos Três. Davi o nomeou comandante de sua guarda pessoal. (11:25).
The mighty men were Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan o filho de Dodo of Bethlehem, (11:26)
Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite, (11:27)
Ira o filho de Ikkesh of Tekoa, Abiezer of Anathoth, (11:28)
Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite, (11:29)
Maharai of Netophah, Heled o filho de Baanah of Netophah, (11:30)
Ithai o filho de Ribai of Gibeah of o povo de Benjamin, Benaiah of Pirathon, (11:31)
Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite, (11:32)
Azmaveth of Baharum, Eliahba the Shaalbonite, (11:33)
the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan o filho de Shagee the Hararite, (11:34)
Ahiam o filho de Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal o filho de Ur, (11:35)
Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite, (11:36)
Hezro of Carmel, Naarai o filho de Ezbai, (11:37)

stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 12
summaryBullets: Ora these are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he could not move about freely because of Saul o filho de Kish. E they were among the mighty men who helped him in war. (12:1)

Todos eles eram arqueiros habilidosos, capazes de atirar flechas com o arco, ou pedras com a funda, tanto com a mão esquerda como com a direita. Eram todos parentes de Saul, da tribo de Benjamim. (12:2).
The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, both sons of Shemaah of Gibeah; also Jeziel e Pelet, os filhos de Azmaveth; Beracah, Jehu of Anathoth, (12:3)
Ishmaiah of Gibeon, a mighty man among the thirty e a leader over the thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad of Gederah, (12:4)
Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Shephatiah the Haruphite; (12:5)
Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, e Jashobeam, the Korahites; (12:6)
and Joelah e Zebadiah, os filhos de Jeroham of Gedor. (12:7)

Alguns guerreiros valentes e treinados para o combate da tribo de Gade também se juntaram a Davi quando ele estava na fortaleza no deserto. Eram hábeis com o escudo e a lança, ferozes como leões e ágeis como gazelas nos montes. (12:8).
Ezer the chief, Obadiah second, Eliab third, (12:9)
Mishmannah fourth, Jeremiah fifth, (12:10)
Attai sixth, Eliel seventh, (12:11)
Johanan eighth, Elzabad ninth, (12:12)
Jeremiah tenth, Machbannai eleventh. (12:13)
These Gadites were officers of the army; the least was a match for a hundred men e the greatest for a thousand. (12:14)
Esses foram os homens que atravessaram o Jordão durante a época de cheia do rio, no início do ano, e expulsaram todos que habitavam nos vales nas margens leste e oeste. (12:15).
Outros de Benjamim e de Judá se juntaram a Davi na fortaleza. (12:16).

David went out to meet them e disse a them, "If you have come to me in friendship to help me, my heart will be joined to you; but if to betray me to my adversaries, although there is no wrong in my hands, then may the God of our fathers see e rebuke you." (12:17)
Então o Espírito veio sobre Amasai, chefe dos Trinta, e ele disse: (12:18).

Alguns homens de Manassés desertaram do exército israelita e se juntaram a Davi quando ele saiu com os filisteus para guerrear contra Saul. Os governantes filisteus, porém, não permitiram que Davi e seus homens fossem com eles. Depois de discutirem, mandaram-no embora, pois disseram: “Se Davi passar para o lado de Saul e voltar-se contra nós, isso custará nossa cabeça”. (12:19).
As he went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh deserted to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, e Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh. (12:20)
Ajudaram Davi a perseguir bandos de saqueadores, pois eram guerreiros valentes que se tornaram comandantes de seu exército. (12:21).
For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like an army of God. (12:22)
Estes são os números de guerreiros armados que se uniram a Davi em Hebrom. Todos queriam que Davi se tornasse rei no lugar de Saul, como o Senhor havia prometido. (12:23).

Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, (14:5)

stories.title: 🛕 1 Crônicas 15
summaryBullets: David built houses for himself in a cidade de David. E he prepared a place for the ark of God e pitched a tent for it. (15:1)
Então David said that no one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, for o SENHOR had chosen them to carry the ark of o SENHOR e to minister to him forever. (15:2)
E David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of o SENHOR to its place, which he had prepared for it. (15:3)
E David gathered together os filhos de Aaron e the Levites: (15:4)
of os filhos de Kohath, Uriel the chief, with 120 of his brothers; (15:5)
of os filhos de Merari, Asaiah the chief, with 220 of his brothers; (15:6)
of os filhos de Gershom, Joel the chief, with 130 of his brothers; (15:7)
of os filhos de Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, with 200 of his brothers; (15:8)
of os filhos de Hebron, Eliel the chief, with 80 of his brothers; (15:9)

So the priests e the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel. (15:14)
E the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of o SENHOR. (15:15)
David also commanded the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brothers as the singers who should play loudly on musical instruments, on harps e lyres e cymbals, to raise sounds of joy. (15:16)
So the Levites appointed Heman o filho de Joel; e of his brothers Asaph o filho de Berechiah; e of os filhos de Merari, their brothers, Ethan o filho de Kushaiah; (15:17)

and with them their brothers of the second order, Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, e Mikneiah, e the gatekeepers Obed-edom e Jeiel. (15:18)
The singers, Heman, Asaph, e Ethan, were to sound bronze cymbals; (15:19)
Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, e Benaiah were to play harps according to Alamoth; (15:20)
but Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, e Azaziah were to lead with lyres according to the Sheminith. (15:21)
Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, should direct the music, for he understood it. (15:22)
Berechiah e Elkanah were to be gatekeepers for the ark. (15:23)
Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, e Eliezer, the priests, should blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom e Jehiah were to be gatekeepers for the ark. (15:24)
So David e the elders of Israel e the commanders of thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of o SENHOR from a casa de Obed-edom with rejoicing. (15:25)
E, como Deus estava claramente ajudando os levitas enquanto carregavam a arca da aliança do Senhor, ofereceram como sacrifício sete novilhos e sete carneiros. (15:26).

summaryBullets: E they brought in the ark of God e set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, e they offered burnt offerings e peace offerings before God. (16:1)

and distributed to all Israel, both men e women, to each a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, e a cake of raisins. (16:3)
Então he appointed some of the Levites as ministers before the ark of o SENHOR, to invoke, to thank, e to praise o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel. (16:4)
Asaph was the chief, e second to him were Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, e Jeiel, who were to play harps e lyres; Asaph was to sound the cymbals, (16:5)
and Benaiah e Jahaziel the priests were to blow trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God. (16:6)
Então on that day David first appointed that thanksgiving be sung to o SENHOR by Asaph e his brothers. (16:7)
"Oh give thanks to o SENHOR; call upon his name; make known his deeds among the peoples!" (16:8)
"Sing to him, sing praises to him; tell of all his wondrous works!" (16:9)
"Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek o SENHOR rejoice!" (16:10)
"Seek o SENHOR e his strength; seek his presence continually!" (16:11)
"Remember the wondrous works that he has done, his miracles e the judgments he uttered," (16:12)
"O offspring of Israel his servant, children of Jacob, his chosen ones!" (16:13)
"He is o SENHOR our God; his judgments are in all the earth." (16:14)
"Remember his covenant forever, the word that he commanded, for a thousand generations," (16:15)
"the covenant that he made with Abraham, his sworn promise to Isaac," (16:16)
"which he confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant," (16:17)
"saying, 'To you I will give a terra de Canaan, as your portion for an inheritance.'" (16:18)
"When you were few in number, of little account, e sojourners in it," (16:19)

"he allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account," (16:21)
"saying, 'Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!'" (16:22)
"Sing to o SENHOR, all the earth! Tell of his salvation from day to day!" (16:23)
"Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples!" (16:24)
"For great is o SENHOR, e greatly to be praised, e he is to be feared above all gods." (16:25)
"For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but o SENHOR made the heavens." (16:26)
"Splendor e majesty are before him; strength e joy are in his place." (16:27)
"Ascribe to o SENHOR, O families of the peoples, ascribe to o SENHOR glory e strength!" (16:28)
"Ascribe to o SENHOR the glory due his name; bring an offering e come before him! Worship o SENHOR in the splendor of holiness;" (16:29)
"tremble before him, all the earth; yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved." (16:30)
"Let the heavens be glad, e let the earth rejoice, e let them say among the nations, 'O SENHOR reigns!'" (16:31)
"Let the sea roar, e all that fills it; let the field exult, e everything in it!" (16:32)
"Então shall the trees of the forest sing for joy before o SENHOR, for he comes to judge the earth." (16:33)
"Oh give thanks to o SENHOR, for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever!" (16:34)
"Say also: 'Save us, O God of our salvation, e gather e deliver us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name e glory in your praise.'" (16:35)
"Blessed be o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel, from everlasting to everlasting!" Então all the people said, "Amen!" e praised o SENHOR. (16:36)
So David left Asaph e his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of o SENHOR to minister before the ark regularly, as each day required, (16:37)
and also Obed-edom e his sixty-eight brothers. Obed-edom, o filho de Jeduthun, e Hosah were to be gatekeepers. (16:38)

stories.title: 📜 1 Crônicas 17
summaryBullets: Ora when David lived in his house, David disse a Nathan the prophet, "Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of o SENHOR is under a tent." (17:1)
E Nathan disse a David, "Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you." (17:2)
But that same night the word of o SENHOR came to Nathan, (17:3)
"Go e tell my servant David, 'Thus says o SENHOR: It is not you who will build me a house to dwell in.'" (17:4)
"For I have not lived in a house since the day I brought up Israel to this day, but I have gone from tent to tent e from dwelling to dwelling." (17:5)

"In all places where I have moved with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?"'" (17:6)
"Ora, therefore, thus shall you say to my servant David, 'Thus says o SENHOR of hosts, I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel,'" (17:7)
Estive com você por onde andou e destruí todos os seus inimigos diante de seus olhos. Agora, tornarei seu nome tão conhecido quanto o dos homens mais importantes da terra! (17:8).
"'And I will appoint a place for my people Israel e will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place e be disturbed no more. E violent men shall waste them no more, as formerly,'" (17:9)
"'from the time that I appointed judges over my people Israel. E I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that o SENHOR will build you a house.'" (17:10)
"'When your days are fulfilled to walk with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring after you, one of your own sons, e I will establish his kingdom.'" (17:11)
"'He shall build a house for me, e I will establish his throne forever.'" (17:12)
"'I will be to him a father, e he shall be to me a son. I will not take my steadfast love from him, as I took it from him who was before you,'" (17:13)
"'but I will confirm him in my house e in my kingdom forever, e his throne shall be established forever.'" (17:14)
In accordance with all these words, e in accordance with all this vision, Nathan spoke to David. (17:15)
Então King David went in e sat before o SENHOR e said, "Who am I, O LORD God, e what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?" (17:16)
"And this was a small thing in your eyes, O God. You have also spoken of your servant's house for a great while to come, e have shown me future generations, O LORD God!" (17:17)
"What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant." (17:18)
"For your servant's sake, O LORD, e according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things." (17:19)
"There is none like you, O LORD, e there is no God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears." (17:20)

"And who is like your people Israel, the one nation on earth whom God went to redeem to be his people, making for yourself a name for great e awesome things, in driving out nations before your people whom you redeemed from Egypt?" (17:21)

stories.title: ⚔️ 1 Crônicas 18
summaryBullets: Depois disso, Davi derrotou e sujeitou os filisteus, conquistando Gate e seus povoados. (18:1).
E he defeated Moab, e the Moabites became servants to David e brought tribute. (18:2)

When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, (18:9)

he sent his son Hadoram to King David, to ask about his health e to bless him because he had fought against Hadadezer e defeated him; for Hadadezer had often been at war with Tou. E he sent all sorts of articles of gold, of silver, e of bronze. (18:10)
These also King David dedicated to o SENHOR, together with the silver e gold that he had carried off from all the nations, from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, e Amalek. (18:11)

stories.title: ⚔️ 1 Crônicas 19
summaryBullets: Ora after this Nahash o rei of the Ammonites morreu, e his son reinou em seu lugar. (19:1)

E David said, "I will deal kindly with Hanun o filho de Nahash, for his father dealt kindly with me." So David sent messengers to console him concerning his father. E David's servants came to a terra de the Ammonites to Hanun to console him. (19:2)
os líderes amonitas disseram a Hanum: “O rei acredita mesmo que esses homens estão aqui para honrar seu pai? Não! Davi os enviou com o objetivo de espionar a terra para vir e conquistá-la!”. (19:3).
So Hanun took David's servants e shaved them e cut off their garments in the middle, at their hips, e sent them away. (19:4)
When David was told about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for the men were greatly humiliated. E o rei said, "Remain at Jericho until your beards have grown e then return." (19:5)
When the Ammonites saw that they had become a stench to David, Hanun e the Ammonites sent 1,000 talents of silver to hire chariots e horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Aram-maacah, e from Zobah. (19:6)
They hired 32,000 chariots e o rei of Maacah with his army, who came e encamped before Medeba. E the Ammonites were mustered from their cities e came to battle. (19:7)
When David heard of it, he sent Joab e all the army of the mighty men. (19:8)
As tropas amonitas avançaram e formaram sua frente de batalha à entrada da cidade, enquanto os outros reis se posicionaram para lutar nos campos abertos. (19:9).
Joabe viu que teria de lutar em duas frentes ao mesmo tempo, por isso escolheu alguns dos melhores guerreiros de Israel e os pôs sob seu comando pessoal para enfrentar os sírios. (19:10).
Deixou o restante do exército sob o comando de seu irmão Abisai, que atacou os amonitas. (19:11).
E he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me, but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will help you." (19:12)
"Be strong, e let us use our strength for our people e for the cities of our God, e may o SENHOR do what seems good to him." (19:13)
Joabe e suas tropas atacaram, e os sírios começaram a fugir. (19:14).
E when the Ammonites saw that the Syrians fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, Joab's brother, e entered the city. Então Joab came to Jerusalem. (19:15)

Os sírios viram que não tinham como enfrentar Israel. Assim, enviaram mensageiros para convocar mais soldados do outro lado do rio Eufrates. Essas tropas eram conduzidas por Sobaque, comandante do exército de Hadadezer. (19:16).

E when it was told to David, he gathered all Israel together e crossed the Jordan e came to them e drew up his forces against them. E when David set the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him. (19:17)
E the Syrians fled before Israel, e David killed of the Syrians the men of 7,000 chariots e 40,000 foot soldiers, e put to death also Shophach the commander of their army. (19:18)
E when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David e became subject to him. So the Syrians were not willing to save the Ammonites anymore. (19:19)

stories.title: ⚔️ 1 Crônicas 20
summaryBullets: No começo do ano, época em que os reis costumavam ir à guerra, Joabe conduziu o exército israelita em ataques bem-sucedidos contra a terra dos amonitas. Durante essas operações, cercou a cidade de Rabá, a atacou e a destruiu. Mas Davi ficou em Jerusalém. Joabe conquistou Rabá e a destruiu. (20:1).

E David took the crown of their king from his head. He found that it weighed a talent of gold, e in it was a precious stone. E it was placed on David's head. E he brought out the spoil of the city, a very great amount. (20:2)

Também tornou os habitantes de Rabá seus escravos e os obrigou a trabalhar com serras, picaretas e machados de ferro. Foi assim que Davi tratou o povo de todas as cidades amonitas. Então ele e todo o exército voltaram para Jerusalém. (20:3).
E after this there arose war with the Philistines at Gezer. Então Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Sippai, who was one of os descendentes de the giants, e the Philistines were subdued. (20:4)
E there was again war with the Philistines, e Elhanan o filho de Jair struck down Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver's beam. (20:5)
Em outra batalha com os filisteus em Gate, havia um homem de grande estatura com seis dedos em cada mão e seis dedos em cada pé, 24 dedos ao todo, que também era descendente de gigantes. (20:6).
E when he taunted Israel, Jonathan o filho de Shimea, David's brother, struck him down. (20:7)
These were descended from the giants in Gath, e they fell by the hand of David e by the hand of his servants. (20:8)

stories.title: ⚔️ 1 Crônicas 21
summaryBullets: Então Satan stood against Israel e incited David to number Israel. (21:1)
So David disse a Joab e the commanders of the army, "Go, number Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, e bring me a report, that I may know their number." (21:2)

But Joab said, "May o SENHOR add to his people a hundred times as many as they are! Are they not, my lord o rei, all of them my lord's servants? Why then should my lord require this? Why should it be a cause of guilt for Israel?" (21:3)
But o rei's word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed e went throughout all Israel e came back to Jerusalem. (21:4)
e informou a Davi o número de pessoas. Havia em Israel 1.100.000 homens aptos para irem à guerra que sabiam manejar a espada e, em Judá, havia 470.000. (21:5).
But he did not include Levi e Benjamin in the numbering, for o rei's command was abhorrent to Joab. (21:6)
But God was displeased with this thing, e he struck Israel. (21:7)
E David disse a God, "I have sinned greatly in that I have done this thing. But now, please take away the iniquity of your servant, for I have acted very foolishly." (21:8)
E o SENHOR spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying, (21:9)
"Go e say to David, 'Thus says o SENHOR, Three things I offer you; choose one of them, that I may do it to you.'" (21:10)
So Gad came to David e disse a him, "Thus says o SENHOR, 'Choose what you will: (21:11)

três anos de fome, três meses de destruição pela espada de seus inimigos, ou três dias de praga intensa, durante os quais o anjo do Senhor trará devastação sobre toda a terra de Israel. Decida o que devo responder àquele que me enviou”. (21:12).
Então David disse a Gad, "I am in great distress. Let me fall into the hand of o SENHOR, for his mercy is very great, but do not let me fall into the hand of man." (21:13)
So o SENHOR sent a pestilence on Israel, e 70,000 men of Israel fell. (21:14)

E Deus enviou um anjo para destruir Jerusalém. Mas, quando o anjo estava prestes a fazê-lo, o Senhor teve compaixão e disse ao anjo da morte: “Pare! Já basta!”. Naquele momento, o anjo do Senhor estava perto da eira de Araúna, o jebuseu. (21:15).

E David lifted his eyes e saw the angel of o SENHOR standing between earth e heaven, e in his hand a drawn sword stretched out over Jerusalem. Então David e the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces. (21:16)

E David disse a God, "Was it not I who gave command to number the people? It is I who have sinned e done great evil. But these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me e against my father's house. But do not let the plague be on your people." (21:17)
Ora the angel of o SENHOR had commanded Gad to say to David that David should go up e raise an altar to o SENHOR on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite. (21:18)
So David went up at Gad's word, which he had spoken in the name of o SENHOR. (21:19)
Araúna debulhava o trigo quando virou-se e viu o anjo. Seus quatro filhos, que estavam com ele, fugiram e se esconderam. (21:20).
Quando Araúna viu que o rei se aproximava, saiu da eira e curvou-se diante de Davi com o rosto no chão. (21:21).
Davi disse a Araúna: “Quero comprar de você esta eira pelo preço justo. Construirei nela um altar para o Senhor, a fim de que ele faça cessar a praga”. (21:22).

Então Ornan disse a David, "Take it, e let my lord o rei do what seems good to him. See, I give the oxen for burnt offerings e the threshing sledges for the wood e the wheat for a grain offering; I give it all." (21:23)
But King David disse a Ornan, "No, but I will buy them for the full price. I will not take for o SENHOR what is yours, nor offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing." (21:24)
So David paid Ornan 600 shekels of gold by weight for the site. (21:25)
E David built there an altar to o SENHOR e presented burnt offerings e peace offerings e called on o SENHOR, e o SENHOR answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of burnt offering. (21:26)
Então o SENHOR commanded the angel, e he put his sword back into its sheath. (21:27)
At that time, when David saw that o SENHOR had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he sacrificed there. (21:28)
Naquela época, o tabernáculo do Senhor, que Moisés havia feito no deserto, e o altar de holocaustos estavam no lugar de adoração em Gibeom. (21:29).
Mas Davi não podia ir até lá para consultar Deus, pois tinha pavor da espada do anjo do Senhor. (21:30).

stories.title: 🪚 1 Crônicas 22
summaryBullets: Então David said, "Here shall be a casa de o SENHOR God e here the altar of burnt offering for Israel." (22:1)
David commanded to gather together the resident aliens who were in a terra de Israel, e he set stonecutters to prepare dressed stones for building a casa de God. (22:2)
Davi providenciou grandes quantidades de ferro para os pregos necessários para as portas e suas dobradiças, e deu tanto bronze que não se podia pesar. (22:3).
and cedar timbers without number, for the Sidonians e Tyrians brought great quantities of cedar to David. (22:4)

Davi disse: “Meu filho Salomão ainda é jovem e inexperiente. Uma vez que o templo do Senhor deve ser um edifício magnífico, famoso e glorioso por todo o mundo, começarei desde já a fazer os preparativos”. Assim, antes de sua morte, Davi juntou grandes quantidades de materiais para a construção. (22:5).
Então he called for Solomon his son e charged him to build a house for o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel. (22:6)
Disse-lhe: “Meu filho, eu quis construir um templo em honra ao nome do Senhor, meu Deus, (22:7).
mas o Senhor me disse: ‘Você matou muitos homens nas batalhas em que lutou. Derramou muito sangue diante de mim, por isso não será você quem construirá um templo em honra ao meu nome. (22:8).

Contudo, você terá um filho que será um homem de paz. Darei a ele descanso de seus inimigos de todas as terras vizinhas. Seu nome será Salomão, e darei paz e tranquilidade a Israel durante seu reinado. (22:9).
"'He shall build a house for my name. He shall be my son, e I will be his father, e I will establish his royal throne in Israel forever.'" (22:10)
"Ora, my son, o SENHOR be with you, so that you may succeed in building a casa de o SENHOR your God, as he has spoken concerning you." (22:11)
"Only, may o SENHOR grant you discretion e understanding, that when he gives you charge over Israel you may keep the law of o SENHOR your God." (22:12)
"Então you will prosper if you are careful to observe the statutes e the rules that o SENHOR commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong e courageous. Fear not; do not be dismayed." (22:13)

"With great pains I have provided for a casa de o SENHOR 100,000 talents of gold, a million talents of silver, e bronze e iron beyond weighing, for there is so much of it; timber e stone, too, I have provided. To these you must add." (22:14)
"You have an abundance of workmen: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, e all kinds of craftsmen without number, skilled in gold, silver, bronze, e iron. Arise e work! O SENHOR be with you!" (22:15)
David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying, (22:16)
Então Davi ordenou a todos os líderes de Israel que ajudassem Salomão nesse projeto. (22:17).
"Ora set your mind e heart to seek o SENHOR your God." (22:18)

Agora busquem o Senhor, seu Deus, de todo o coração e de toda a alma. Construam o santuário do Senhor Deus, a fim de trazer a arca da aliança do Senhor e os utensílios sagrados para o templo edificado em honra ao nome do Senhor.” (22:19).

summaryBullets: When David was old e full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel. (23:1)

"4,000 gatekeepers, e 4,000 shall offer praises to o SENHOR with the instruments that I have made for praise." (23:5)

Os filhos de Gershon were Ladan e Shimei. (23:7)
Os filhos de Ladan: Jehiel the chief, e Zetham, e Joel, three. (23:8)
Os filhos de Shimei: Shelomith, Haziel, e Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers' houses of Ladan. (23:9)
E os filhos de Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, e Beriah. These four were os filhos de Shimei. (23:10)
Jahath was the chief, e Zizah the second; but Jeush e Beriah did not have many sons, so they became counted as a single father's house. (23:11)
Os filhos de Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, e Uzziel, four. (23:12)

Os filhos de Amram: Aaron e Moses. Aaron was set apart to dedicate the most holy things, that he e his sons forever should make offerings before o SENHOR e minister to him e pronounce blessings in his name forever. (23:13)
But os filhos de Moses the man of God were named among a tribo de Levi. (23:14)
Os filhos de Moses: Gershom e Eliezer. (23:15)
Os filhos de Gershom: Shebuel the chief. (23:16)
Os filhos de Eliezer: Rehabiah the chief. Eliezer had no other sons, but os filhos de Rehabiah were very many. (23:17)
Os filhos de Izhar: Shelomith the chief. (23:18)
Os filhos de Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, e Jekameam the fourth. (23:19)
Os filhos de Uzziel: Micah the chief e Isshiah the second. (23:20)
Os filhos de Merari: Mahli e Mushi. Os filhos de Mahli: Eleazar e Kish. (23:21)
Eleazar morreu having no sons, but only daughters; their kinsmen, os filhos de Kish, married them. (23:22)
Os filhos de Mushi: Mahli, Eder, e Jeremoth, three. (23:23)

Estes foram os descendentes de Levi conforme seus clãs, os chefes de suas famílias, registrados por nome. Cada um precisava ter 20 anos ou mais a fim de se qualificar para o serviço na casa do Senhor. (23:24).
For David said, "O SENHOR, o Deus de Israel, has given rest to his people, e he dwells in Jerusalem forever." (23:25)
"And so the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the things for its service." (23:26)
For by the last words of David, os filhos de Levi were numbered from twenty years old e upward. (23:27)

O trabalho dos levitas era ajudar os sacerdotes, os descendentes de Arão, no serviço da casa do Senhor. Também cuidavam dos pátios e das salas laterais, ajudavam a realizar as cerimônias de purificação e serviam na casa de Deus de várias outras maneiras. (23:28).

Their duty was also to assist with the showbread, the flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baked offering, the offering mixed with oil, e all measures of quantity or size. (23:29)
E they were to stand every morning, thanking e praising o SENHOR, e likewise at evening, (23:30)
and whenever burnt offerings were offered to o SENHOR on Sabbaths, new moons, e feast days, according to the number required of them, regularly before o SENHOR. (23:31)
E assim, sob a supervisão dos sacerdotes, os descendentes de Arão, os levitas guardavam a tenda do encontro e o santuário e cumpriam seus deveres no serviço da casa do Senhor. (23:32).

stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 24
summaryBullets: The divisions of os filhos de Aaron were these. Os filhos de Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, e Ithamar. (24:1)
But Nadab e Abihu morreu before their father e had no children, so Eleazar e Ithamar became the priests. (24:2)
With the help of Zadok of os filhos de Eleazar, e Ahimelech of os filhos de Ithamar, David organized them according to the appointed duties in their service. (24:3)

Since more chief men were found among os filhos de Eleazar than among os filhos de Ithamar, they organized them under sixteen heads of fathers' houses of os filhos de Eleazar, e eight of os filhos de Ithamar. (24:4)
They divided them by lot, all alike, for there were sacred officers e officers of God among both os filhos de Eleazar e os filhos de Ithamar. (24:5)

Semaías, filho do levita Natanael, foi o secretário e anotou os nomes e as tarefas na presença do rei, dos líderes, do sacerdote Zadoque, de Aimeleque, filho de Abiatar, e dos chefes das famílias dos sacerdotes e dos levitas. Os descendentes de Eleazar e de Itamar foram designados por sorteio alternadamente. (24:6).
The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah, (24:7)
the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim, (24:8)
the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin, (24:9)
the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah, (24:10)
the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah, (24:11)
the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim, (24:12)
the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab, (24:13)
the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer, (24:14)
the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez, (24:15)
the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel, (24:16)
the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul, (24:17)
the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah. (24:18)

These had as their appointed duty in their service to come into a casa de o SENHOR according to the procedure established for them by Aaron their father, as o SENHOR God of Israel had commanded him. (24:19)
E of the rest of os filhos de Levi: of os filhos de Amram, Shubael; of os filhos de Shubael, Jehdeiah. (24:20)
Of Rehabiah: of os filhos de Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief. (24:21)
Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of os filhos de Shelomoth, Jahath. (24:22)
Os filhos de Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth. (24:23)
Os filhos de Uzziel: Micah; of os filhos de Micah, Shamir. (24:24)
The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of os filhos de Isshiah, Zechariah. (24:25)
Os filhos de Merari: Mahli e Mushi. Os filhos de Jaaziah: Beno. (24:26)
Os filhos de Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, e Ibri. (24:27)
Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons. (24:28)
Of Kish, os filhos de Kish: Jerahmeel. (24:29)
Os filhos de Mushi: Mahli, Eder, e Jerimoth. These were os filhos de the Levites according to their fathers' houses. (24:30)

Como os descendentes de Arão, suas tarefas foram designadas por sorteio, sem distinção de idade nem de posição entre as famílias. As sortes foram lançadas na presença do rei Davi, de Zadoque, de Aimeleque e dos chefes das famílias dos sacerdotes e dos levitas. (24:31).

stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 25
summaryBullets: Depois, Davi e os comandantes do exército nomearam homens das famílias de Asafe, Hemã e Jedutum para profetizar, com o acompanhamento de liras, harpas e címbalos. Esta é a lista de seus nomes e de suas responsabilidades: (25:1).
Of os filhos de Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, e Asharelah, sons of Asaph, under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of o rei. (25:2)

Of Jeduthun, os filhos de Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, e Mattithiah, six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre in thanksgiving e praise to o SENHOR. (25:3)
Of Heman, os filhos de Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth. (25:4)
All estes foram os filhos de Heman o rei's seer, according to the promise of God to exalt him, for God had given Heman fourteen sons e three daughters. (25:5)

Todos esses homens estavam sob a direção de seus pais e serviam como músicos na casa do Senhor. Eram responsáveis por tocar címbalos, harpas e liras na casa de Deus. Asafe, Jedutum e Hemã se reportavam diretamente ao rei. (25:6).
Eles e suas famílias estavam preparados para cantar diante do Senhor, e todos, 288 no total, eram músicos talentosos. (25:7).
E they cast lots for their duties, small e great, teacher e pupil alike. (25:8)
The first lot fell for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, to him e his brothers e his sons, twelve; (25:9)

stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 26
summaryBullets: Estas são as divisões dos guardas das portas: (26:1).
E Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah o primogénito, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth, (26:2)
Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh. (26:3)
E Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah o primogénito, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth, (26:4)
Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth, for God blessed him. (26:5)
Semaías, filho de Obede-Edom, teve filhos muito capazes, que ocuparam posições de grande autoridade no clã. (26:6).
Os filhos de Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers were able men, Elihu e Semachiah. (26:7)
All estes foram of os filhos de Obed-edom with their sons e brothers, able men qualified for the service; sixty-two of Obed-edom. (26:8)
E Meshelemiah had sons e brothers, eighteen able men. (26:9)
E Hosah, of os filhos de Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not o primogénito, his father made him chief), (26:10)
Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons e brothers of Hosah were thirteen. (26:11)
These divisions of the gatekeepers, corresponding to their chief men, had duties, just as their brothers did, ministering in a casa de o SENHOR. (26:12)
E they cast lots by fathers' houses, small e great alike, for their gates. (26:13)
Meselemias e seu grupo ficaram responsáveis pela porta leste. Seu filho Zacarias, conselheiro de grande sabedoria, ficou responsável pela porta norte. (26:14).
Obede-Edom ficou responsável pela porta sul, e seus filhos, pelo depósito. (26:15).
For Shuppim e Hosah it came out for the west, at the gate of Shallecheth on the road that goes up. Watch corresponded to watch. (26:16)
On the east there were six Levites, on the north four a day, on the south four a day, e at the gatehouse two e two. (26:17)
E for the colonnade on the west there were four at the road e two at the colonnade. (26:18)
These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the Korahites e os filhos de Merari. (26:19)
Outros levitas, sob a liderança de Aías, eram encarregados dos tesouros da casa de Deus e dos depósitos onde ficavam os objetos consagrados. (26:20).
Os filhos de Ladan, os filhos de the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers' houses belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli. (26:21)
Os filhos de Jehieli, Zetham, e Joel his brother, were in charge of the treasuries of a casa de o SENHOR. (26:22)
Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, e the Uzzielites -- (26:23)
Do clã de Anrão, Sebuel foi descendente de Gérson, filho de Moisés. Era o oficial encarregado dos tesouros. (26:24).
His brothers: from Eliezer were his son Rehabiah, e his son Jeshaiah, e his son Joram, e his son Zichri, e his son Shelomoth. (26:25)
Selemote e seus parentes eram encarregados dos tesouros que o rei Davi, os chefes das famílias, os generais e capitães e outros oficiais do exército haviam dedicado ao Senhor. (26:26).
From spoil won in battles they dedicated gifts for the maintenance of a casa de o SENHOR. (26:27)
Also all that Samuel the seer e Saul o filho de Kish e Abner o filho de Ner e Joab o filho de Zeruiah had dedicated -- all dedicated gifts were in the care of Shelomoth e his brothers. (26:28)
Of the Izharites, Chenaniah e his sons were appointed to outside duties for Israel, as officers e judges. (26:29)

Do clã de Hebrom, Hasabias e seus parentes, 1.700 homens capazes, foram encarregados das terras israelitas a oeste do rio Jordão. Eram responsáveis por todas as questões relacionadas ao serviço do Senhor e do rei nessa região. (26:30).

Também do clã de Hebrom, Jerias era o chefe dos hebronitas, de acordo com os registros genealógicos. No quadragésimo ano do reinado de Davi, fez-se uma busca nos registros e foram encontrados homens capazes do clã de Hebrom em Jazer, na terra de Gileade. (26:31).

Havia 2.700 homens capazes e chefes de família entre os parentes de Jerias. O rei Davi os enviou para o lado leste do Jordão e os encarregou das tribos de Rúben e Gade e da meia tribo de Manassés. Eram responsáveis por todas as questões relacionadas a Deus e ao rei. (26:32).

stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 27
summaryBullets: This is the list of o povo de Israel, the heads of fathers' houses, the commanders of thousands e hundreds, e their officers who served o rei in all matters of the divisions that came e went, month after month throughout the year, each division numbering 24,000: (27:1)
Jasobeão, filho de Zabdiel, era comandante da primeira divisão de 24 mil homens, de serviço durante o primeiro mês. (27:2).
Era descendente de Perez e chefe de todos os oficiais do exército para o primeiro mês. (27:3).
Dodai, descendente de Aoí, era comandante da segunda divisão de 24 mil homens, de serviço durante o segundo mês. Miclote era o chefe da divisão. (27:4).
The third commander, for the third month, was Benaiah, o filho de Jehoiada the chief priest; in his division were 24,000. (27:5)
Esse Benaia comandou o grupo militar de elite de Davi, conhecido como os Trinta. Seu filho Amizabade era o chefe da divisão. (27:6).
Asahel the brother of Joab was fourth, for the fourth month, e his son Zebadiah after him; in his division were 24,000. (27:7)
The fifth commander, for the fifth month, was Shamhuth the Izrahite; in his division were 24,000. (27:8)
Sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira, o filho de Ikkesh the Tekoite; in his division were 24,000. (27:9)
Seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, of os filhos de Ephraim; in his division were 24,000. (27:10)
Sibecai, de Husate, descendente de Zera, era comandante da oitava divisão de 24 mil homens, de serviço durante o oitavo mês. (27:11).
Ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer of Anathoth, a Benjaminite; in his division were 24,000. (27:12)
Maarai, de Netofate, descendente de Zera, era comandante da décima divisão de 24 mil homens, de serviço durante o décimo mês. (27:13).
Eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah of Pirathon, of os filhos de Ephraim; in his division were 24,000. (27:14)
Twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; in his division were 24,000. (27:15)
Estas foram as tribos de Israel e seus líderes: (27:16).
for Levi, Hashabiah o filho de Kemuel; for Aaron, Zadok; (27:17)
for Judah, Elihu, one of David's brothers; for Issachar, Omri o filho de Michael; (27:18)
for Zebulun, Ishmaiah o filho de Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth o filho de Azriel; (27:19)
da tribo de Efraim: Oseias, filho de Azazias; (27:20).
for the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo o filho de Zechariah; for Benjamin, Jaasiel o filho de Abner; (27:21)
for Dan, Azarel o filho de Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel. (27:22)
David did not count those below twenty years of age, for o SENHOR had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of heaven. (27:23)
Joabe, filho de Zeruia, começou o censo, mas nunca o terminou, porque a ira de Deus caiu sobre Israel. O número total nunca foi anotado nos registros oficiais do rei Davi. (27:24).
Azmavete, filho de Adiel, era encarregado dos depósitos do palácio. (27:25).
and over those who did the work of the field for tilling the soil was Ezri o filho de Chelub; (27:26)
Simei, de Ramá, era encarregado dos vinhedos. (27:27).
Over the olive e sycamore trees in the Shephelah was Baal-hanan the Gederite; e over the stores of oil was Joash. (27:28)
Over the herds that pastured in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; over the herds in the valleys was Shaphat o filho de Adlai. (27:29)
Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite; e over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite. (27:30)
All estes foram stewards of King David's property. (27:31)
Jonathan, David's uncle, was a counselor, being a man of understanding e a scribe. Jehiel o filho de Hachmoni attended o rei's sons. (27:32)
Ahithophel was o rei's counselor, e Hushai the Archite was o rei's friend. (27:33)
Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada o filho de Benaiah, e Abiathar. Joab was commander of o rei's army. (27:34)

stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 28
summaryBullets: Davi convocou todos os oficiais de Israel para irem a Jerusalém: os líderes das tribos, os comandantes das divisões do exército, os generais e os capitães, os administradores das propriedades e dos rebanhos do rei, os oficiais do palácio, os guerreiros valentes, e todos os outros soldados do reino. (28:1).

Davi se pôs em pé e disse: “Meus irmãos e meu povo! Era meu desejo construir um templo onde a arca da aliança do Senhor, o lugar de descanso dos pés de nosso Deus, repousasse para sempre. Fiz os preparativos necessários para construí-lo, (28:2).
"But God disse a me, 'You shall not build a house for my name, for you are a man of war e have shed blood.'" (28:3)

"Yet o SENHOR God of Israel chose me from all my father's house to be king over Israel forever. For he chose Judah as leader, e in a casa de Judah my father's house, e among my father's sons he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel." (28:4)
E, dentre os muitos filhos que o Senhor me deu, escolheu Salomão para ser meu sucessor no trono de Israel e para governar o reino do Senhor. (28:5).
"He disse a me, 'It is Solomon your son who shall build my house e my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, e I will be his father.'" (28:6)
"'I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues strong in keeping my commandments e my rules, as he is today.'" (28:7)

“Agora, portanto, com Deus como nossa testemunha, e diante de todo o Israel, a comunidade do Senhor, eu lhes digo: tenham o cuidado de obedecer a todos os mandamentos do Senhor, seu Deus, para que continuem a possuir esta boa terra e a deixem para seus filhos como herança permanente. (28:8).

"And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father e serve him with a whole heart e with a willing mind, for o SENHOR searches all hearts e understands every plan e thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever." (28:9)
"Be careful now, for o SENHOR has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary; be strong e do it." (28:10)

Então Davi entregou a seu filho Salomão as plantas do templo e de tudo que ficava ao redor, incluindo a sala de entrada, os depósitos, as salas dos andares superiores, as salas internas e o lugar de expiação. (28:11).

Davi também entregou a Salomão as plantas de tudo que havia planejado para os pátios do templo do Senhor, das salas externas, dos tesouros e dos depósitos para as ofertas dedicadas ao Senhor. (28:12).
Deu, ainda, instruções a respeito das divisões dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, além das responsabilidades no templo do Senhor e das especificações para os objetos usados no serviço do templo. (28:13).
the weight of gold for all golden vessels for each service, the weight of silver vessels for each service, (28:14)

Informou a quantidade de ouro necessária para os candelabros e as lâmpadas de ouro, e a quantidade de prata necessária para os candelabros e as lâmpadas de prata, de acordo com o uso de cada um. (28:15).
Especificou a quantidade de ouro para a mesa sobre a qual seriam colocados os pães da presença, e a quantidade de prata para as outras mesas. (28:16).
Davi também especificou a quantidade de ouro puro para os garfos, as bacias, os jarros e as tigelas, bem como a quantidade de prata para as tigelas. (28:17).

Especificou, ainda, a quantidade de ouro refinado para o altar de incenso. E, por fim, entregou-lhe o projeto para o trono do Senhor, os querubins de ouro cujas asas se estendiam sobre a arca da aliança do Senhor. (28:18).
Davi disse a Salomão: “Todos os detalhes dessas plantas me foram escritos sob a direção do Senhor”. (28:19).

E continuou: “Seja forte e corajoso e faça o trabalho. Não tenha medo nem desanime, pois o Senhor Deus, meu Deus, está com você. Ele não o deixará nem o abandonará durante toda a construção do templo do Senhor. (28:20).
As divisões dos sacerdotes e dos levitas servirão no templo do Senhor. Outros, com todo tipo de habilidade, se oferecerão para ajudar, e os oficiais e todo o povo estarão às suas ordens”. (28:21).
