stories.title: 👑 1 Crônicas 29
summaryBullets: O rei Davi se voltou para toda a comunidade e disse: “Meu filho Salomão, que Deus escolheu, ainda é jovem e inexperiente. O trabalho que ele tem pela frente é enorme, pois o templo que ele construirá não será para meros humanos, mas para o Senhor Deus. (29:1).

Usando todos os recursos a meu dispor, juntei o que pude para a construção do templo de meu Deus. Agora, há ouro, prata, bronze, ferro e madeira suficientes, bem como grandes quantidades de ônix e outras pedras preciosas, joias caras, todo tipo de pedra da melhor qualidade e mármore. (29:2).

"Moreover, in addition to all that I have provided for the holy house, I have a treasure of my own of gold e silver, e because of my devotion to a casa de my God I give it to a casa de my God:" (29:3)
Ofereço 105 toneladas de ouro de Ofir e 245 toneladas de prata refinada para revestir as paredes das construções, (29:4).
e para os outros trabalhos em ouro e prata a serem feitos pelos artesãos. Quem seguirá meu exemplo e entregará, hoje, ofertas ao Senhor?”. (29:5).
Então the leaders of fathers' houses made their freewill offerings, as did also the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of thousands e of hundreds, e the officers over o rei's work. (29:6)
They gave for the service of a casa de God 5,000 talents e 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, e 100,000 talents of iron. (29:7)
Também contribuíram com pedras preciosas, que foram guardadas no tesouro da casa do Senhor, sob os cuidados de Jeiel, descendente de Gérson. (29:8).
Então the people rejoiced because they had given willingly, for with a whole heart they had offered freely to o SENHOR. David o rei also rejoiced greatly. (29:9)
Therefore David blessed o SENHOR in the presence of all the assembly. E David said: "Blessed are you, O LORD, o Deus de Israel our father, forever e ever." (29:10)
Ó Senhor, a ti pertencem a grandeza, o poder, a glória, a vitória e a majestade. Tudo que há nos céus e na terra é teu, ó Senhor, e este é teu reino. Tu estás acima de tudo. (29:11).
"Both riches e honor come from you, e you rule over all. In your hand are power e might, e in your hand it is to make great e to give strength to all." (29:12)
"And now we thank you, our God, e praise your glorious name." (29:13)
"But who am I, e what is my people, that we should be able thus to offer willingly? For all things come from you, e of your own have we given you." (29:14)
"For we are strangers before you e sojourners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are like a shadow, e there is no abiding." (29:15)
"O LORD our God, all this abundance that we have provided for building you a house for your holy name comes from your hand e is all your own." (29:16)

"I know, my God, that you test the heart e have pleasure in uprightness. In the uprightness of my heart I have freely offered all these things, e now I have seen your people, who are present here, offering freely e joyously to you." (29:17)
"O LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, e Israel, our fathers, keep forever such purposes e thoughts in the hearts of your people, e direct their hearts toward you." (29:18)
"Grant to Solomon my son a whole heart that he may keep your commandments, your testimonies, e your statutes, performing all, e that he may build the palace for which I have made provision." (29:19)
Então David disse a all the assembly, "Bless o SENHOR your God." And all the assembly blessed o SENHOR, the God of their fathers, e bowed their heads e paid homage to o SENHOR e to o rei. (29:20)

E they offered sacrifices to o SENHOR, e on the next day offered burnt offerings to o SENHOR, 1,000 bulls, 1,000 rams, e 1,000 lambs, with their drink offerings, e sacrifices in abundance for all Israel. (29:21)
E they ate e drank before o SENHOR on that day with great gladness. E they made Solomon o filho de David king the second time, e they anointed him as prince for o SENHOR, e Zadok as priest. (29:22)
Então Solomon sat on the throne of o SENHOR as king in place of David his father. E he prospered, e all Israel obeyed him. (29:23)
All the leaders e the mighty men, e also all os filhos de King David, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon. (29:24)
O Senhor exaltou Salomão diante de todo o Israel e lhe deu mais esplendor que qualquer outro rei de Israel antes dele. (29:25).
Thus David o filho de Jesse reigned over all Israel. (29:26)
The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years. He reigned seven years in Hebron e thirty-three years in Jerusalem. (29:27)
Então he morreu at a good old age, full of days, riches, e honor. E Solomon his son reinou em seu lugar. (29:28)
Todos os acontecimentos do reinado de Davi, do início ao fim, estão escritos no Registro do Vidente Samuel, no Registro do Profeta Natã e no Registro do Vidente Gade, (29:29).
incluindo os grandes feitos de seu reinado e tudo que aconteceu com ele, com Israel e com todos os reinos vizinhos. (29:30).
